    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_VisitSplit" name="Site visits or interviews needed?" default="Flow_SkipVisits">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_VisitDone</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_VisitJoin" name="Visit evaluation merged">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_VisitDone</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SkipVisits</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_NegotiateContract" name="Negotiate contract terms">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_SignContract" name="Sign contract once terms are agreed">

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_Onboarded" name="Supplier onboarded and contract executed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_NeedIdentified" targetRef="Task_IssueRFP"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Gateway_VisitJoin" targetRef="Task_SelectSupplier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Task_SelectSupplier" targetRef="Task_NegotiateContract"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_NegotiateContract" targetRef="Task_SignContract"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_SignContract" targetRef="Task_OnboardSupplier"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Task_OnboardSupplier" targetRef="EndEvent_Onboarded"/>
